name: Vancouver International Airport

curfew.v: Night period midnight-06:00 local: departures of jets rated over 34,000 kg MTOW need YVR's prior approval; flights carrying passengers or cargo from YVR are approved, ferry and refuelling-stop departures generally refused. No restriction stated for arrivals or lighter jets
curfew.quote: A prior approval requirement for departures of jet aircraft rated over 34,000 kg.

noise.v: North runway 08L/26R closed every night 22:00-07:00 except emergencies and south airfield maintenance; south runway 08R/26L and crosswind 13/31 remain
noise.quote: the north runway is closed every night between the hours of 10:00 PM and 7:00 AM

slots.v: YVR is an IATA Level 3 slot-coordinated airport: all commercial, charter, cargo and general or business aviation operators must have a pre-approved runway slot. GA/BA slots are booked only through the Online Coordination System (OCS); the page says to book through OCS or your FBO. Visiting operators can book within 72 hours of the flight, based operators within 14 days. VFR helicopters are exempt
slots.quote: All commercial, charter, cargo, and GA/BA operators must book slots.

permits.v: Canadian Transportation Agency: non-scheduled international services to and from Canada are licensed by the Agency (exemptions to the licence duty exist; that notice was not read). For a licensed airline with aircraft under 15,900 kg MCTOW, no charter permit, notices or reports, except a foreign licensee flying between Canada and a country other than its home country, which must apply for a charter permit. At 15,900 kg or more the rule depends on route and passengers or goods; check the CTA guide. Guide page last modified 14 Dec 2020
permits.quote: you do not have to apply for a charter permit or send us any notices or reports.

runway.v: South runway 08R/26L 11,500 ft (about 3,505 m), north 08L/26R 9,940 ft (about 3,030 m), crosswind 7,300 ft (about 2,225 m; called 12/30 then, 13/31 in newer YVR documents). Metres converted from feet (x 0.3048). From the 2014-2018 plan, an old document: the latest found that gives lengths
runway.quote: the 11,500 feet south runway (08R/26L); the 9,940 feet north runway (08L/26R); and the 7,300 feet crosswind runway (12/30)

deicing.v: YVR has a Central De-icing Facility with aircraft bays and 29 de-icing trucks; the page does not say who de-ices or whether business aviation uses the facility
deicing.quote: YVR hosts a Central De-icing Facility with aircraft bays.
